comment: web-ext lint warnings that are expected for a GeckoView built-in extension. Every other warning fails tools/check.sh. Match is on code and file; add an entry only with a reason.

warnings.reason: geckoViewAddons is a GeckoView-only permission that AMO's linter does not know. GeckoView needs it for built-in extensions that use GeckoView-specific APIs; twin-bridge is never published on AMO.
